request: Turn the reference into a layered paper diorama.

references.notes: The single source image supplies the depicted person and travel-memory environment; no outfit/style import beyond visible source content unless requested.

body_transformation.anatomy_change: none unless explicitly stated in request
body_transformation.artistic_stylization: only when selected by body mode/art method

director.moment: the traveler pauses under a tree before a distant waterside path
director.action: small human figure integrated into landscape rather than dominating it
director.hand_logic: hands mostly contained by robe/gesture; no extra props unless source requires
director.background: mist/blank paper opening into distant landscape
director.camera: pictorial scroll space, no photographic lens language
director.light_source: paper and ink value rather than literal spotlight
director.material_response: calligraphic brush line, wet/dry ink, absorbent paper, reserved blank space
director.micro_story: a remembered journey reduced to brush rhythm and atmospheric absence
